steps.title: Open the cockpit
steps.narration: Start on the home page, where you can watch any ticker's live tape.
steps.point_out: The page opens with no ticker watched yet — the natural starting point before choosing one.

steps.title: Type a ticker to watch
steps.narration: Enter SIM-BUYER, one of the app's built-in simulated tickers used to demonstrate how the tape reading works.
steps.point_out: The Ticker field is ready to accept a symbol.

steps.title: Watch the simulated buyer tape
steps.narration: Click Watch, and the cockpit reads the live tape and settles on a state once there's enough evidence.
steps.point_out: The tape settles to "buyer_control," with an event log explaining why — rising prints and a tightening spread.

steps.title: Return to the cockpit
steps.narration: Head back to the home page to pick a different ticker.
steps.point_out: The cockpit resets cleanly, ready for the next symbol.

steps.title: Type a second ticker to watch
steps.narration: This time enter SIM-SELLER — the matching simulated ticker for seller-driven tape.
steps.point_out: The Ticker field accepts a new symbol before clicking Watch again.

steps.title: Watch the simulated seller tape
steps.narration: Click Watch again, and this time the tape reads the other way.
steps.point_out: The state settles to "seller_control," driven by falling prints and rising seller aggression.

steps.title: Check the trade journal
steps.narration: The Journal page keeps a running record of what the cockpit has observed.
steps.point_out: The Journal page loads and is ready to hold entries.

steps.title: Replay past studies
steps.narration: The Studies page lets you replay historical tape sessions to study how they played out.
steps.point_out: "Replay studies" confirms the replay tools are ready to use.

steps.title: Review strategy performance
steps.narration: The Performance page tracks how each strategy has done, anchored to a fixed research configuration so results stay comparable over time.
steps.point_out: The configuration fingerprint shown on screen confirms the underlying research setup hasn't drifted.

steps.title: Explore price structure
steps.narration: The Structure page shows the price-structure research tools, including the strategies registered so far for backtesting on real market bars.
steps.point_out: The strategy registry confirms the research tools are present and loaded.
